description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. 
 
 
 The SRE Strategy and Governance Lead drives consistent standards, best practices, and measurable improvements across Site Reliability Engineering. This role coordinates priorities, tracks commitments, and provides clear reporting to help teams improve service reliability and operational performance.
  
 Key Responsibilities 

 Define and maintain SRE standards, governance practices, and operational guidelines.
 Partner with engineering and operations teams to adopt best practices and address gaps.
 Translate strategic goals into clear priorities, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
 Coordinate cross-team initiatives, track progress and dependencies, and escalate risks or delays.
 Establish KPIs and metrics covering reliability, service performance, incident response, and operational maturity.
 Develop dashboards and reporting that highlight trends, risks, progress, and areas for improvement.
 Lead regular performance reviews and ensure agreed actions are completed.
 Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, consistent processes, and shared accountability.

 Skills and Experience 

 Experience in technology governance, operational excellence, or SRE-related environments.
 Strong planning, coordination, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
 Ability to establish standards and influence adoption across teams.
 Experience defining KPIs, analyzing metrics, and producing clear leadership reporting.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information into actionable insights.
 Working knowledge of SRE principles, including service-level objectives, incident response, and continuous improvement.
 
 Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $200,000.00- $230,000.00 USD.
 Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
 Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
 Benefits Information: Please visit www.broadridgebenefits.com for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings for this role
